f.pu: Located on the eastern side of Saipan Island, Forbidden Island is a nearshore volcanic island with adjacent fringing reefs. The island is less than 1 hectare in size and can be accessed from the adjacent Kagman Wildlife Conservation Area or from the sea during calm weather. The primary motivation w…
f.re: The Forbidden Island Marine Sanctuary is a no-take marine protected area. Damaging coral is prohibited. Destruction, harassment and/or removal of plants, wildlife including birds, turtles, fish and marine species of any kind, fishing in any form, operation of jet skis, walking on exposed sections of the reef, taking or removal of fish, shellfish or marine life in any form is prohibited.

f.pu: Tank Bay is a crescent shaped bay with fringing reefs and numerous tidepools, located on the eastern side of Saipan Island. Designated as a species reserve, the area serves to insure continuous high levels of productivity of trochus. This site has been overlaid by the Forbidden Island Sanctuary.
f.re: Taking of trochus is prohibited. The Forbidden Island Marine Sanctuary that overlays Tank Beach is a no-take marine protected area, meaning that human activities such as fishing, feeding fish, and collecting sand and shells are all prohibited.
f.ma: Mariana Islands Division of Fish and Wildlife
